not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

server_error.title: Something went wrong
server_error.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again in a moment.

E_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
E_LOGIN_BLOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {duration}.
E_INVALID_INVITATION: This invitation is invalid or expired.
E_INVALID_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN: This link is invalid, expired or already used.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: This page is reserved to administrators.

E_LAST_ADMIN: There must remain at least one administrator.
E_OWN_ADMIN_RIGHTS: You cannot remove your own administrator rights.
E_OWN_ACCOUNT_DELETION: You cannot delete your own account from the administration.
E_VIVARIUM_ARCHIVED: This tank is archived: unarchive it to change it.
E_INVALID_IMAGE: This image cannot be read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
E_TRACKED_MEASURE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This parameter is already tracked on this tank.
E_INVALID_TRACKED_MEASURE_ORDER: The list changed in the meantime: reload the page and try again.
E_READING_CONFLICT: This reading already has a value of {types} at this date and time. Edit the existing reading from the history.
